Numpool Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. The island features Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, two Nazca Railway Stations, and is connected to Route 4. While the island once was entirely a part of West Metropolis Archipelago, following subsequent changes of the border between Downtown and West Metropolis Archipelago, the eastern part of the island is now a part of Downtown.

Location[]

Numpool Island is at the east of West Metropolis Archipelago. It is named after the fact that, before the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals was built, this island had a large number of natural lakes.

Numpool Station is a station on West Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Metro Express Transport Leanpool Line (Numpool Station)[2].

Fun Facts[]

  • The West Ring Line platforms of this station are located at Y=110, and was the station with the highest altitude in Los Sengas Division until the completion of Flask Line East Margin Station at Y=115, which not only replaced this station as the highest station in Los Sengas Division, but also replaced Taiiin Hill Station as the highest station ever built in Nazca Railway. However, while East Margin Station still has the highest platforms in Nazca Railway, the record of the highest Nazca Railway structure bulit returned to this station when the Charlie Line passing tracks at this station were built at Y=117.
  • Being situated at Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals Numpool Terminal, this station is the first station to be situated on completely reclaimed land.
  • This station once was the first and only Elevated station in West Metropolis Archipelago. However, the station now is in Downtown district due to border being redrawn. Therefore, there are no longer any elevated stations in West Metropolis Archipelago.

History[]

  • August 15 2015: This station began services.
  • May 13 2016: Charlie Line structure is added to the station. North Numpool Bridge and South Numpool Bridge completed reconstruction.[3]
  • June 22 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • June 9 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • April 6 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Numpool Terminal is one of the piers of Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals. It is located at Los Sengas West Metropolis Archipelago Numpool Island.

  • Terminal Number: 3

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • The first offshore terminal built in Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.
  • Completed alongside West Ring Line Numpool Station.
  • The area of the Reclamation Area is roughly equivalent to the existing landmass of Numpool Island.

Oasis Bay Line is Line Number 17 of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line has 24 stations and runs between Grandview Bay and Cyban. It was established alongside Wooden Abyss Station on January 13 2017.

Description []

Oasis Bay Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Jupiter, Oasis Bay, Oasis, Prymea and Borealis.

This route is represented by Light Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 17.

Currently, this route is km long, with a total of 24 stations.

History[]

  • S2E10: Cansand Bay - Southern Heights
  • S3E4: Europa - Tat Stone Hill (This section belongs to the now-defunct West Oasis Bay Line)
  • S3E8: Europa - Southern Heights
  • S3E13P1: Grandview Bay - Southern Heights
  • S4E11: Grandview Bay - Cyban

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Down Extend Westwards from Grandview Bay Station to the South of Twenty-Second Continent and Teraleros through the Archipelago at Strait of Freedom. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Southeast from Southern Heights Station to the East Borealis continent through Spring Point Gateway. Under Construction
(Chapter: S4E11)
Down Extend Westwards from Grandview Bay Station to Joyhill Island and Sandshore Island before proceeding west to Teraleros. TBC

Districts Served[]

  • Jupiter
  • Oasis Bay
  • Oasis
  • Prymea
  • Borealis

Line Charcteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • Shares colors with the now-defunct West Oasis Bay Line.
  • This line adopts the "Bridge Core Design" at parts of the elevated section.
  • Oceanfloor Tubes are briefly seen on this line after Bottom Woods Station. This makes Oasis Bay Line to be the third line after Gondola Line and Stadow Line to adopt Oceanfloor Tubes.
  • Express Services of this line:
    • Echo Line : Europa to Tat Stone Hill[1]

Fun Facts[]

  • Between S3E4 and S3E7, this line had two completely separate tracks (With the West between Europa and Tat Stone Hill, and the East between Cansand Bay and Southern Heights, with the former being named the West Oasis Bay Line and Nazca Railway stating in multiple instances that West Oasis Bay Line is marked as a part of this line in its official documentation. Eventually, the two separate sections are connected in S3E8.
  • This line, as well as three of its stations (Grandview Bay Station, Top Hill Bay Station, Cansand Bay Station), have the word "Bay" in it. Moreover, the three aforementioned stations are the first station in the Up Direction of three different districts (Grandview Bay Station for Jupiter, Top Hill Bay Station for Oasis Bay, Cansand Bay Station for Oasis). However, this is no longer the case in S4E11 when this line extends to Prymea and Borealis. (The first station in these two districts are Pinewatch and Cyban respectively)

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is likely named after the fact that this station serves as a gateway between Sava and Odyssey.
  • This Station is the first Ground Station where the Y-Axis of the Platforms is lower than 63.

Location[]

Offak Isle is located to the east of Brain Island and the west of Compass Island. It is also connected to Brain Island by a pedestrian footbridge.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station pays tribute to the Oganesson Element on the Periodic Table. However, as the Chinese name of this station involves an Chinese Word on the Extension H of the CJK Unified Ideographs, it is not possible to type the Chinese Word on the computer.
  • This station features a Periodic Table of Elements at its south end. A similar Periodic Table of Elements can be seen at Golden Division Golden House Station.
  • This station was originally named Quantum Lowlands Station. However, to commemorate the Oganesson Element, this station is renamed Oganesson Station. Despite this, the Station Code of this station is QOW, which corresponds to the Original English name.
  • A Station art featuring the English Name and Chinese Name of the Station can be seen at the sides to the south and the south end wall of this station respectively.

History[]

  • April 27 2018: This station began services.
  • August 17 2018: Unicode begins to support the Chinese Name of this Station.[2]

History[]

 Old Brightland[]

In the narrower sense, Old Brightland only includes the area to the east of Koishi Road and the south of Gangut Road. Folklores have suggested the existence of a duke in the Old Brightland Area who built his Cottage in where Ayanami Street is today. As that duke had given financial help to many villagers in times of natural disasters, the villagers nearby had revered him and named him "The Bright Duke". Tragically, the cottage remained empty after his death as he did not have any offsprings, and the Cottage was hence named "Old Brightland" in order to commeorate him.

As time goes by, the cottage fell in disrepair, and after Nawis Railway begun construction begun in Old Brightland, a concensus was made with the residents of that area to demolish the cottage under the conditions that residents can move into the new Private Housing in Old Brihgtland for free. Most residents involved currently live in Wing Lok Building, and the building is one of the main private housing developments in Old Brightland. Currently, these buildings are home to a population of 5'000.

Myosotis Valley[]

Myosotis Valley refers to the area to the west of Koishi Road, the south of Old Brightland Avenue and the east of Echo Road South. Myosotis Valley used to be a low valley that is home to a small settlement. While the settlement was originally named "Tsurume", the name changed to Myosotis Valley for a mysterious reason. However, legends have it that a traveller who was chased down by a Mafia Gang Member went in hiding in this settlement and fell in love with one of the female villagers. While the both of them fell in love and could have lived happily ever after, the Mafia Gang member managed to find this settlemenet, and in order to not harm the innocents, the traveller left a farewell letter to the girl at dawn. In turn, the girl told him that she will hold a "forget-me-not" flower to wait for him, but he never returned. To commemorate this tragic love story, Tsurume was renamed Myosotis Valley.

When development in Myosotis Valley began, the developer promised that the villagers could live in Tin Lok Gardens for free in order to gain support from villagers. Currently, Myosotis Valley has a series of private housing, as well as two public housing estates, and is home to 6'000 people.

Island Gales[]

Island Gales refer to the area near Island Gales Station of Nawis Railway. While there are no residents in that area before development, legends have it there used to be an island which lays in the middle of a river mouth, and people who stand on that island could feel large gales blowing towards him, hence the name Island Gales. However, the River Mouth has since been reclaimed due to development. Currently, Island Gales has a few separate private housing buildings and is home to the only Secondary School in this area.

Future Development[]

Currently, development in Myosotis Valley and Old Brightland South is complete, but the Old Brightland University to the northeast is still under construction. It is seen that once this university complete constructions, 40'000 quotas can be given for university students.
